unchangedPolicy: Negotiation span selection, weights, budgets and caller physical publication guards retained; search implementation and numeric work accounting differ.
geometryScope: Uses repair04 conservative pad shapes and exact native capsule/disk/rotated-rectangle distance checks.
experiment: Native lazy contact/tangent search with outward chord error at most gridSize*0.02; finite event support is not continuous completeness.
counterSemantics: All prefix experimental numeric fields are per-query additive work counts except names containing Maximum, which max-merge. P9 Joint stats sum both bounded stages, including live queries. Heap-pop allowance is unchanged; geometry, indexing references, congestion candidates/primitive checks, history, and support generation are reported separately and are not treated as free.
policyChanges: Event supports discovered from blocked planar/via segments and positive congestion costs, not all-pairs visibility preconstruction.
Native offset geometry is circumscribed at maximum radius error 0.02*grid pitch and clipped to crop. Exact clearance validates every used edge.
Complete earlier-via-set labels replace native one-label grid dominance. No point-count equivalence or full continuous completeness is claimed.

Original minimum-distance-times-length congestion callback is evaluated for each event edge; its score changes with segmentation, so this is a graph/objective-policy experiment, not a semantics-preserving shortcut.
stateIdentity: Coordinate, full prior-via set, and future-transition metadata (event outline/vertex/edge for theory 4; certified cell bounds for theory 5). This avoids merging labels whose generated successor sets differ.
completenessLimit: The discovered obstacle support graph is a bounded route candidate representation, not a proof of continuous completeness or Euclidean optimality. Dynamic discovery does not re-expand every earlier label whenever a new outline appears. Failed/no-path means exhausted this event graph, not physical UNSAT.
